plainText:
Clemont's Magnemite (Japanese: シトロンのコイル Citron's Coil) was one of the three Gym acquired by in .

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
Sometime before , owned a Magnemite and lent it to Clembot while he and were out of the Lumiose Gym.

Magnemite debuted in Clemont's Got a Secret when and snuck in the Lumiose Gym. It served as a patrol for the Lumiose Gym while Clembot was in control of it. After Clemont greeted Magnemite upon his return, it was initially happy but then remembered its orders and attacked him with . It continued attacking until 's Frubbles put a stop to it. Magnemite was then seen along with the other Pokémon cheering for Clemont after defeating Clembot.
 
In A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!, Magnemite was added back into Clemont's active party in preparation for his upcoming Gym battle with Ash. After Clemont's Gym battle with Ash in The Moment of Lumiose Truth, Magnemite was left back with Clembot.

In Battling With a Clean Slate!, Magnemite was the first Pokémon used by Clembot in a Gym battle with a named Alvin. It started the battle with , but was stunned by 's - combo. After being put to sleep with , Magnemite was quickly defeated by an .

===Personality and characteristics===
Magnemite is very loyal both to Clemont and Clembot, albeit to a fault, as shown when Clembot's orders for it to attack any intruders led to it attacking Clemont, also demonstrating how it takes orders from either of them very seriously.

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
Clemont owns multiple Magnemite in Pokémon Adventures and uses them alongside other Pokémon to power the Prism Tower during a blackout. They first appeared in Pangoro Poses a Problem.
